title: Bellfussy's Brilliance Bundle!
description: A carefully handpicked modpack catering to the more adventurous side of Minecraft modding!
body: Have you ever wanted to see what's jus tbeyond that distant mountain, or at the bottom of that deep cliff, or what lurks out in the far heavens? Well now you can! This kitchen sink modpack aims to breath life into the world and to give the player the desire to seek what's just over that next hill by providing plenty of new structures, dimensions, and bosses to explore! This pack includes the staples like Ad Astra, The Aether, L_Ender's Cataclysm, and so much more!
